changelog:
**Signature phrase rotation and anti-repeat logic for openers/closers; more natural AI-ification**

- Added guidance to rotate sycophantic openers and open-ended closers—never parrot the same line twice in a row, and aim for signature line usage in only 30–50% of responses.
- Introduced a requirement to avoid using any recently-used signature phrase (within last 3 turns) to prevent mechanical repetition.
- Emphasized generating fresh, AI-flavored sentences instead of simply reciting template phrases; treat provided lines as few-shot examples rather than strict patterns.
- Clarified that maintaining structural Agentizer "flavor" is mandatory, but phrasing should be varied for more natural—yet still maximal—AI-ification.
